title: A young man carries the sleeping woman into the pink bedroom, lays her on the…
content: A young man carries the sleeping woman into the pink bedroom, lays her on the bed and covers her with the blanket, then switches off the light and lies down at the foot of the bed on top of the pink blanket, turned away from her with his eyes closed, the room falling dark but his movement still faintly visible.
